solution.title: SharePoint Online Architecture & Site Provisioning Governance

products.name: SharePoint Online Architecture & Site Provisioning Governance — Commercial
products.short_description: Design the SharePoint Online architecture & provisioning governance — hub/site structure, site templates, a request→approve→provision process with naming, taxonomy, and lifecycle — so sites are consistent and governed. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Design a SharePoint Online architecture that stays organized as it grows

Without an architecture, SharePoint Online becomes thousands of ungoverned sites nobody can navigate. This solution designs the SPO information architecture and provisioning governance: hub-and-site structure, site types and templates, a provisioning process (request → approve → provision) with naming, metadata/taxonomy (managed metadata), and lifecycle — so sites are consistent, findable, and governed from creation.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the IA + provisioning model: hubs/sites, site types + templates, provisioning workflow, naming, taxonomy, and lifecycle.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (SPO admin, group source of truth, taxonomy owners, provisioning tooling, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — design the hub/site structure, define site templates, build the provisioning process (PnP templates + approval) with naming + metadata, and set lifecycle — pilot-first, each hub/site/template named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (sites provisioned to standard, hubs associated, taxonomy applied) plus Best Practices for a governed, navigable SPO estate.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A SharePoint estate that stays organized as it grows — hubs and sites structured, provisioned to a standard, named and tagged, lifecycle-governed — consistent and findable.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-SPOGovernanceComplianceReport.ps1 — Read-only governance compliance report for the SPO architecture / provisioning standard
    • Get-SPOScopeConfig.ps1 — Read-only scope/health helper: verifies the toolchain, connection, and governance settings
    • Invoke-SPOArchitectureAssessment.ps1 — Read-only discovery of the SharePoint Online estate for an architecture/provisioning assessment
    • New-SPOSiteFromTemplate.ps1 — Provision a SharePoint Online site from a PnP template, named + hub-associated + tagged
    • Set-SPOHubAndMetadata.ps1 — Associate an existing SPO site to its hub and apply naming/metadata to bring it into compliance

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
